cells.gaps: No source gives a share or count of health centres entering their own reports; the only facility-level statement of none is one district in 2018 (TCD-027), which does not carry the country. Tiers disagree: TCD-019 (2023) has hospitals on DHIS2 with a slow migration, TCD-028 (2018) has health centres and district hospitals reporting on paper. Finance is donor on a 2021 fact outside the 36 months, so not stated inside the window; plan:current rests on PNDS 4 2022-2030 (TCD-022), since the 2025 strategy does not name the system.
cells.note: Districts key the health centres' monthly paper reports into DHIS2 (Gavi audit, August 2024; 96.4% of districts entering in 2022), which is the whole of rung 3. Rung 4 needs entry at the facility by more than half of primary clinics, and extending DHIS2 to health centres is still a planned action.
